subsystems.name: Sample acquisition and inlet
subsystems.role: brings ice, brine, sediment or gas into the instrument without adding contaminants of its own.

subsystems.name: Separation front end
subsystems.role: spreads a complex mixture out so individual molecules can be counted one at a time.
parts: chiral stationary phase for left/right-handed separation

subsystems.name: Mass analyser
subsystems.role: weighs ions precisely and breaks them apart to reveal how their atoms were joined.

subsystems.name: Complexity scorer
subsystems.role: converts spectra into a number describing how hard the molecule would be to build without biology.
parts: reference libraries of abiotic and biotic molecules

subsystems.name: Orthogonal biosignature channels
subsystems.role: independent checks that do not rely on the complexity metric at all.
parts: chirality measurement by circular dichroism or chiral chromatography
chemical disequilibrium sensors, e.g. co-present oxygen and methane

subsystems.name: Contamination control
subsystems.role: keeps Earth's own complex molecules from being mistaken for an alien detection.
parts: sealed sample path with no reusable surfaces

buildSteps.title: Define the signal and the null
buildSteps.detail: Decide what counts as biology-agnostic complexity, and assemble reference samples whose origin is known — meteoritic organics and laboratory abiotic syntheses on one side, Earth biology on the other.

buildSteps.title: Choose and prepare samples
buildSteps.detail: Take ice, brine, sediment or gas and keep it cold and sealed so fragile large molecules survive the trip into the instrument.

buildSteps.title: Separate the mixture
buildSteps.detail: Chromatography or electrophoresis spreads thousands of compounds across time so the detector is not swamped by a single blended signal.

buildSteps.title: Ionise gently
buildSteps.detail: Electrospray or a soft laser turns molecules into intact ions rather than shattering them, preserving the structure that carries the information.

buildSteps.title: Measure mass and fragment
buildSteps.detail: Tandem mass spectrometry records each ion's mass, then deliberately breaks it into pieces, giving a graph of which atoms were bonded to which.

buildSteps.title: Compute a complexity score
buildSteps.detail: The reconstructed graph is scored by assembly index or a related metric, with a threshold above which abiotic synthesis is argued to be implausibly unlikely.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and blind-test
buildSteps.detail: Run the pipeline on samples where the answer is known, then on samples where it is hidden, to measure how often the metric is simply wrong.

buildSteps.title: Package it for flight
buildSteps.detail: Shrink pumps, column, analyser and electronics into a sealed, radiation-tolerant unit and test it in cold deserts, subglacial lakes and other stand-in environments.

prerequisites.why: near-identical molecular formulas and structural fragments must be resolved before any complexity number is trustworthy.
large fragile molecules have to reach the detector intact or the complexity signal is destroyed on the way in.
flight instruments have a fraction of a laboratory's pumping speed, sample volume and solvent handling.
assembly theory's threshold is actively debated, and no metric has been shown to separate all biology from all abiotic chemistry.
abiotic chemistry, including in meteorites and hydrothermal settings, makes surprisingly large molecules, which sets a demanding bar.

prerequisites.tech: Chiral separation and detection on tiny samples
prerequisites.why: a strong left/right-handedness bias is one of the best biology-agnostic clues, but measuring it in micrograms of sample is hard.

pathway.milestone: benchmark complexity scoring against a broad set of known biotic and abiotic samples
pathway.unlocks: honest error bars, and a clear idea of whether the metric says anything useful.

pathway.milestone: fly a compact mass-spectrometry suite to a plume or subsurface setting on an ocean-world or Mars mission
pathway.unlocks: real measurements from an environment that has never hosted Earth life.

pathway.milestone: combine complexity, chirality, isotope ratios and chemical disequilibrium into one detection claim
pathway.unlocks: a result that survives sceptical review rather than resting on a single contested metric.

pathway.milestone: a standard instrument package that can be repeated across ocean worlds and used to interpret exoplanet atmospheres
pathway.unlocks: the ability to search for life as we do not know it as a routine capability rather than a one-off experiment.
